note: After the revision by Constantino (1995); the original is in English. Alates, soldiers and large workers are described. Soldier measurements: 5 soldiers from 5 colonies, head length 5.60—6.20 mm, maximum head width 4.50—5.20 mm, head height without postmentum 3.00—3.30 mm, frontal tube length 0.24—0.30 mm, left mandible length 2.40—2.55 mm, curvature 0.80—0.90 mm. OCR word breaks ('2.liO', '2.8,5-3.10') have been corrected from the context.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate is most similar to S. parallelus and S. longiceps, but both are smaller, have more distinctly angular anterior corners of the pronotum and only 2 setae on the postclypeus. The soldier is characterized by the elongate head with nearly parallel sides, the stout mandibles with weak teeth and the weakly developed thoracic spines; some soldiers of S. longiceps from the central Amazon may resemble it, but the latter is always larger and has small marginal teeth on both mandibles.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Compound eyes small, less than 1/4 of the head width; ocelli small; fontanelle round and relatively small. Antennae 19 or 20-segmented. Anterior corners of the pronotum moderately angular. Wings short, apex of the mediana and cubitus distinct. Head capsule with a few scattered short setae; postclypeus with 2 hairs at the anterior margin and 2 near the middle; outer margin of the pronotum hairy.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule elongate, the sides nearly parallel; posterior margin of the head round. Frontal tube prominent, the pore not visible in dorsal view. Labrum short, length and width subequal; lateral angles about right-angled; midlobe short. Antennae 19-segmented. Postmentum not constricted, the sides of the posterior part nearly parallel. Mandibles short and stout, the teeth weak.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: head capsule with a few scattered short setae; postclypeus with 4 setae; fontanelle round and small. Antennae 19—20-segmented. Thoracic spines moderately developed. Mandibles very similar to S. longiceps; hind gut also similar to S. longiceps. Measurements (4 individuals from 4 colonies, mm): head length 2.40—2.60; maximum head width 2.85—3.10.
